correctness.rationale: For exactly two indistinguishable particles on the positive-rate four-site periodic ASEP, the six-state generator defined by rate pw_i/qw_i is irreducible. The matrix-tree stationary weights yield the two displayed exact cofactor polynomial identities: N=4abcd(p-q)(p+q)(p²+q²)(Ap+Bq)(Aq+Bp) and ND_rev+N_revD=-4abcd pq(a-c)(b-d)(p-q)²(p+q)(p²+q²)(Ap+Bq)(Aq+Bp)[α(p²+q²)+βpq]. Denominators are positive for 0<|ε|<1, and the quadratic H is affine in ε². The reflection iff follows from H identically zero, α=β=0, the positive-pair AM-GM contradictions when A!=B, and matching opposite-site sums/products when A=B. The exact witness (1,2,4,9) has α=-46 β=106, reversal ε²=7/99. The source exact SymPy cofactor checker was inspected; separately implemented six-state rational stationary solves corroborated the expressions. No inference extends to larger cycles or bias endpoints.
